data.name: ActiviteNesda
data.value: Activities of the National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency

data.name: ActiviteNesdaText
data.value: The privileges of the NESDA’s mechanism cover the phases of setting up micro-enterprises and expanding their activity. The mechanism also includes various vital economic sectors to encourage entrepreneurship and investment in Algeria.

data.name: ActiviteP1Text
data.value: Support for the creation of micro-enterprises for young entrepreneurs includes financing, administrative and technical assistance, providing the necessary training and ensuring project follow-up from the beginning until the start of activity.

data.name: ActiviteP2Text
data.value: It aims to develop the current activity of micro-enterprises by adding new production lines, diversifying products, or launching complementary or independent new activities to expand the scope of work and increase revenues.

data.name: ActiviteTitre1P2
data.value: Not having previously benefited from any support mechanism to create a micro-enterprise.

data.name: ActiviteTitre1P3
data.value: having a certificate or professional qualification and/or recognized knowledge and skills certified.

data.name: ActiviteTitre1P4
data.value: Providing a personal financial contribution according to one of the selected financing.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P1
data.value: Registration via the digital platform after training at one of the Entrepreneurship Development Centers.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P2
data.value: The Agency’s services evaluate the project using a risk assessment system based on feasibility, efficiency, and financing criteria, and submit it to the Wilaya Committee if the evaluation exceeds 50%.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P3
data.value: The project holder presents the project to the committee for selecting, approving, and financing investment projects (CSVF) at the Wilaya.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P4
data.value: The Agency issues the eligibility and financing certificate upon committee approval and initiates administrative procedures with relevant departments and suppliers.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P4Titre
data.value: Issuance of Eligibility and Financing Certificate

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P5
data.value: The project begins after completing all procedures with the Agency.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P6
data.value: In case of project rejection, an appeal can be filed with the Secretariat of the Committee within 15 days of notification. If rejected finally, the National Appeals Committee may be approached.

data.name: FinancementTitre1Text
data.value: The financing solutions offered by the agency have the following features:

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP1
data.value: Unremunerated loan to finance the creation of micro-enterprises and the expansion of their activities

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP2
data.value: Project funding can reach up to 10,000,000 DZD

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP3

data.name: FinancementTitre2p1Text

data.name: FinancementTitre2p2Text

data.name: FinancementTitre2p3Text
data.value: The project holder contributes between 5% and 15%, the Agency contributes between 15% and 25%, and the bank covers the remaining 70%.

data.name: PolitiqueText
data.value: Protecting your personal data is an absolute commitment to us. This policy aims to inform you clearly and transparently about how your personal data is collected and processed by the National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency (NESDA).

data.name: PolitiqueTitre10Text
data.value: For any questions regarding our current privacy and cookie policy, or to exercise your rights, you can contact NESDA:

data.name: PolitiqueTitre1P1
data.value: As part of its activities, the National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency (NESDA), hereinafter referred to as "NESDA," collects, processes, and stores personal data. The protection of this data is an absolute obligation for all NESDA employees, in full compliance with the provisions of Law No. 18-07 of June 10, 2018, concerning the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre1P2
data.value: NESDA, whose registered office is located at 8, Arezki Ben Bouzid Street – El Anasser, Algiers, acts as the data processor for data collected via its website.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre2P
data.value: By using the website “www.nesda.dz” and the links available on it, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy and agree to the collection, processing, use and storage of your information in accordance with the methods described below, in compliance with the provisions of Law No. 18-07 dated 25 Ramadan 1439 corresponding to 10 June 2018 relating to the protection of natural persons in the field of processing of personal data.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre3P1
data.value: The legitimacy, integrity, and transparency of the process

data.name: PolitiqueTitre3P2
data.value: Defining and limiting the purposes of treatment

data.name: PolitiqueTitre3P6
data.value: Data integrity and confidentiality, including processing security

data.name: PolitiqueTitre3P7
data.value: Respecting the rights of the individuals concerned

data.name: PolitiqueTitre3Text
data.value: NESDA is committed to respecting all fundamental principles relating to the protection of personal data in accordance with applicable legislation, in particular with regard to the following:

data.name: PolitiqueTitre4P1Text
data.value: Name, Surname, Nickname, Date of Birth, National Identification Number (NIN), Bank Account Number (RIB) / Postal Current Account Number (CCP), Social Security Number.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre4P2Text
data.value: Landline or mobile phone number, postal address, email address.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre4P3
data.value: Data on banking operations and transactions:

data.name: PolitiqueTitre4P3Text
data.value: The nature of the transactions, the date, details of the card payments, transfers, deductions, amount, and statement.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre4P4Text
data.value: Your authentication IDs and data in your connected spaces, login logs, cookies and other tracking tools, website browsing data (IP address, browser type, pages visited, etc.).

data.name: PolitiqueTitre4Text
data.value: When you use NESDA services and its website, the following categories of personal data may be collected:

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5P1
data.value: Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations;

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5P11
data.value: Proper operation of the information system;

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5P2
data.value: Training, support, establishment and promotion of micro-enterprises;

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5P3
data.value: Account management and relationship with promoters and partners;

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5P5
data.value: Preventing, detecting, and investigating cases of non-payment and fraud;

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5P9
data.value: Information systems, people, and property security;

data.name: PolitiqueTitre5Text
data.value: NESDA processes personal data collected in order to fulfill its tasks and within one or more of the following purposes:

data.name: PolitiqueTitre6ST12
data.value: These are essential for the proper functioning of the website and enable you to use its basic functions.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre6ST22
data.value: These collect information about how visitors use our website.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre6ST32
data.value: These allow the website to remember your choices and preferences.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre6ST42
data.value: Used to show you more relevant ads.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre6Text
data.value: The website “www.nesda.dz” uses cookies and other tracking technologies to improve user experience, personalize content, and analyze website traffic.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7Text
data.value: According to Law No. 18-07 on the Protection of Personal Data, you have the following rights with regard to your personal data:

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP12
data.value: To obtain confirmation of whether personal data relating to you is being processed

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP22
data.value: Request to correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP32
data.value: Requesting the erasure of your personal data in certain cases

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP42
data.value: Request to restrict the processing of your data under certain circumstances

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP52
data.value: To object to the processing of your data for legitimate reasons

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP62
data.value: To obtain your data in a structured and machine-readable format

data.name: PolitiqueTitre7TextP72
data.value: You can withdraw your consent at any time when the processing is based on that consent.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre8P1
data.value: NESDA takes appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security commensurate with the risks, in order to protect your personal data from destruction, loss, alteration or unauthorized disclosure.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre8P2
data.value: These measures include the use of anonymization and data encryption techniques, ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of processing systems, data recovery procedures, as well as strict confidentiality clauses for employees.

data.name: PolitiqueTitre9Text
data.value: NESDA retains your personal data only for the time necessary for the purposes for which it was collected and processed, in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory obligations. The retention period is determined based on the purposes of processing, operational constraints, and legal limitation periods.
